name: neutronsync
description: NeutronSync keeps local folders and Proton Drive in sync. This container runs the headless engine and the browser interface. Open the WebUI on first visit to set up your web login. Find the setup code in the container log. NEUTRONSYNC_WEB_PASSWORD is an optional advanced setting. Narrow the /data path to the shares you sync. Not affiliated with Proton AG.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Config, state, encrypted session, web login data and logs

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Default local root for folder pairs. Narrow this to the shares you sync instead of the whole array.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User id that owns files under /config

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group id that owns files under /config

variables.name: Web Password
variables.description: Optional. Leave empty to set up your web login on first visit to the WebUI using the setup code in the container log. If set, use at least 12 characters.

variables.name: Web auth mode
variables.description: Leave empty for password login. Set to proxy only behind a reverse proxy that logs people in (disables the web login page).

variables.name: Session Key
variables.description: Optional. 32-byte key (base64) for the encrypted Proton session. Pass this separately from /config so a copied appdata folder alone cannot decrypt the session.
